final: The Remixer as on this page, with Melissa's 10 Nov editor pass from the UX doc (Remix puzzle mobile).
summary: A remix puzzle inside a story (Operation: COPY//WRITE, Loc 3i). crisp-E hands the player a painting and the Remixer: three tabs of one-tap tools (Mix it, Shape it, Wreck it). Save unlocks after any 2 different tools. Saving shows crisp-E's reaction and lets the player share the image.

rows.then: crisp-E's chat bubbles pop in, with the painting already partly scrambled and its caption.
Opens the editor on the Mix it tab.
Goal reads “Use 2 tools to remix it” with two empty pips. Save it is disabled. Undo, Redo and Start over are disabled.
One pip fills: “Nice. 1 more tool to remix it”. The tool's tile gets a folded corner.
Both pips fill: “Remixed! Keep going or save it.” Save it turns on.

rows.when: Tap a tool you just used
rows.then: Gives a different version (its tile shows a re-roll mark). It doesn't count as a new tool.

rows.when: Switch tab (Mix it, Shape it, Wreck it)
rows.then: Shows that tab's four tools. The picture and the count stay.
Saves the remix to the gallery and opens Loc 3j.
Tray: take a photo, choose one, or “No pic handy? Try a sample”. Then a Size slider with Cancel and Stick it on.
Stamps the photo onto the painting. Toast: “Stuck on. Looking good.”
A sheet of options previewed on the current picture, Original first. Picking one wipes the new look across. Only one Colour and one Contrast apply at a time; Original removes it.
Rolls a random Colour + Contrast (never Original), names it in a toast. Tap again to re-roll. One Undo goes back to before the surprise. Counts as one tool.

rows.when: Tap Dot, Pixel, Facet or Glass
rows.then: Rebuilds the picture in that shape. A Size slider (fine to chunky) opens in the strip above Save; nothing else moves.
Pieces get bigger or smaller. Glass draws dark lines between pieces, thicker as pieces grow; Facet has no lines.
Resets the slider to its start value.
Applies it at once. Shuffle's tile previews the exact next shuffle.

rows.when: Tap Marble, then drag on the picture
rows.then: Pulls the paint into swirls over whatever look is applied. Tap Marble again to stop.
Drops a lens on the picture. Drag it to move, drag its edge to resize, Bulge slider pushes in or out, + adds another lens. It saves as you go.
Steps back or forward one change. Toast: “Undone” / “Redone”.
Back to crisp-E's starting picture, history cleared, tool count back to 0, Save disabled.
“✓ Saved to your gallery” stamp over the remix, then crisp-E: “YES”, “get wrecked park people”, “you can post it if you want”, #messwithQ.
Opens the phone's share sheet with the image and “I remixed a masterpiece in Story City #messwithQ”. Without a share sheet, the image downloads and the text is copied.
Back to the editor with the remix and tool count kept.
Continues the story to the next location.

back.then: Back to Loc 3i. Edits are kept if they reopen it (to confirm).
Closes the sheet without changing the picture.
Same as Bork it more: editor, remix kept (to confirm).

events.name: remix_tool_used
events.props: tool (me, recolour, contrast, surprise, dots, pixel, shapes, glass, glitch, shuffle, marble, lens), tab, used_count

events.name: remix_saved
events.props: tools (distinct, sorted, comma-joined), tool_count, undo_count, restarted (true/false)

events.name: photo_puzzle_completed
events.when: The photo puzzle's completion event. The remix events follow the same naming.

edgeCases: Using the same tool twice counts once. Undo doesn't take a tool off the count; only Start over resets it.
Taps on tools, Undo and Redo are ignored while an effect is animating.
Save stays disabled under 2 different tools, even after many changes with one tool.
Square images not tested yet (from the UX doc).
“Surprise me” / “Surprends-moi” may clip in TitleMedium on the smallest phones; check both languages.
Saved image is full size and must match the screen: replay the same steps at full resolution.
notes: Already built in part: mobile editor in mobile-rn #1402 (feature/SC-3583-remix-puzzle) and remix activity on feature/SC-3603-remix-activity-mobile. Server and creator tools not built yet.
UX doc: Remix puzzle mobile in the Story City App database. Design review tasks NSC-2071 to NSC-2079 are Ready for Review with Melissa.
Open (from the UX doc): add a feature flag, since only the server not sending REMIX hides it? Should tool tiles preview the current remix rather than the original?
